Get Guidance on CSCA Preparation & Academic Readiness

If you have questions about the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), preparation options, mock tests, or academic readiness planning, the CSCA International team is here to help.
Whether you are exploring CSCA for the first time or are actively preparing for the exam, you can contact us for clear, structured, and honest guidance — without confusion or false promises.
How CSCA International Can Help You
You may contact CSCA International for guidance on:
• Understanding CSCA requirements and purpose
• CSCA preparation strategies and readiness planning
• Diagnostic and practice mock tests
• CSCA handbooks and study resources
• Coaching and training centre inquiries
• General questions related to CSCA academic readiness
Important: CSCA International provides preparation and academic guidance only.
We do not conduct the CSCA exam or issue official results.

Start Your Global Journey

CSCA International is an independent academic preparation and guidance platform for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), supporting international students with structured readiness planning, mock tests, and CSCA-aligned study resources. We provide preparation and guidance only and are not an exam-conducting authority and do not guarantee admissions or outcomes. Our Pakistan offices are located in Islamabad (G-8 Markaz) and Lahore (Gulberg-III), with online guidance available for students across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
